result.summary: The interface is largely well-structured, with minor issues regarding filter state consistency and text contrast.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is active, but the displayed restaurants feature poké, burgers, and ramen instead of pizza.
issues.suggestion: Filter the displayed items to match the selected 'Pizza' category or set 'All' as active.

issues.description: Placeholder text inside the search bar has low contrast against the input background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text to meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
